### Unfair Account Suspensions and False Accusations

Multiple users reported being banned without clear proof or explanation, often accused of “botting” despite using the platform legitimately. These sudden account suspensions waste time and effort, creating distrust among creators and brands relying on campaign consistency.

### Poor Customer Support

Users describe Drope.me’s support team as dismissive, closing chatbot conversations without investigating reported issues. Complaints highlight unanswered emails and ignored tickets, leaving marketers with unresolved problems that directly affect campaign ROI.
